effects: Pulls exactly `amount` ZKL (the vault's collateral 0xfC385A…, set at init and never changed) from the signer to the vault with safeTransferFrom. This spends the signer's prior ZKL allowance to the vault.
Credits active vault shares to `onBehalfOf`, not to the signer. The number of shares comes from the vault's stake and share totals in storage.
The deposited stake becomes restaked collateral that can be slashed, and it can only leave through withdraw/redeem and then claim after an epoch delay.
formats.shown: "Deposit 123.25 ZKL for <beneficiary>", with the vault, the ZKL amount and the beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: shares credited to onBehalfOf are computed from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`. The descriptor has no shares field, and no calldata value holds the shares.
findings.fix: None needed. Calldata does not carry the share count.

effects: Burns the signer's active vault shares worth `amount` ZKL, rounded up (previewWithdraw with Ceil). The signer's active stake drops by `amount`.
Queues `amount` ZKL into the next epoch's withdrawal pool and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim them after that epoch ends (epoch is 7 days).
The queued amount can still be slashed until it is claimed, so the claimer may get less than `amount`. No tokens move in this transaction.
formats.shown: "Request 2.5 ZKL withdrawal for <claimer>", with the vault, the ZKL amount and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the queued amount can be slashed before claim, so the claim may pay less than shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol onSlash reduces `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]` and `withdrawals[currentEpoch_]`. withdrawalsOf then pays pro rata from the reduced pool. The descriptor shows 'Requested assets' as a fixed amount.
findings.fix: Optionally label the amount 'Requested assets (before any slashing)'.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent does not say that funds arrive only after an epoch delay and a separate claim.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; ... withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares;` and _claim requires `epoch < currentEpoch()`. The intent is 'Request withdrawal'.
findings.fix: Optionally use 'Request withdrawal (claimable after next epoch)'.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Converts the burned shares to ZKL at the current stake/share rate and queues that amount into the next epoch's withdrawal pool, credited to `claimer`. The ZKL amount is computed from storage.
`claimer` can claim the ZKL after the next epoch ends. The queued amount can still be slashed. No tokens move now.
formats.shown: "Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for <claimer>", with the vault, the raw share integer and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is a raw 18-decimal integer, but a unit format could render it.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` has format "raw". The case 2 screen shows '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares have the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format "unit" with params {"base":"shares","decimals":18}, so the screen reads about 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the ZKL value of the redeemed shares is computed from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares());`. No calldata value carries it.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed. This consumes the signer's claim for that epoch.
Sends withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) ZKL from the vault to `recipient`. The amount is computed from storage and may be reduced by slashing.
formats.shown: "Claim epoch 42 to <recipient>", with the vault, the epoch number and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claim: the screen never names the asset (ZKL) that is sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The intent is 'Claim withdrawal' and the interpolated intent is 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. No field mentions ZKL.
findings.fix: Use 'Claim ZKL withdrawal' and 'Claim ZKL from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the ZKL amount paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender);`. The amount is not in the calldata.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Sends the sum of withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) over all listed epochs, in ZKL, from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer. The amount is computed from storage.
formats.shown: "Claim epochs 42 and 44 and 128 to <recipient>", with the vault, each epoch and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never names the asset (ZKL) that is sent to the recipient.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. The intent is 'Claim withdrawals' and the interpolated intent is 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.
findings.fix: Use 'Claim ZKL withdrawals' and 'Claim ZKL from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total ZKL paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);`, which reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender) from storage.
